Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (PHN16-71) RTX 4060?

The Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (PHN16-71) RTX 4060 features a 140W Max TGP (Full Power MUX Switch) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 8GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen4 slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (PHN16-71) RTX 4060 scores 9.9/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i7-13700HX (16 Cores: 8P + 8E, 24 Threads, up to 5.0 GHz, Liquid Metal) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
